verdict.rationale: Meltano documents that its transformations are implemented with dbt (meltano-docs-6) and that `meltano run` executes EL(T) pipelines (meltano-docs-37, meltano-docs-33). It also claims to run dbt workflows alongside other pipelines in one place (meltano-docs-25). Together this implies dbt can run as a step after loading, not just on a timer, but no item states that dbt waits for and runs against the just-loaded data. The orchestration evidence (meltano-docs-7) mentions only scheduled runs via Airflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing a tap → target → dbt sequence in a single run, dependency gating on load completion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
